Round-trip: Stage 1 → generated text → Stage 2

STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: autovcoder_103163.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: autovcoder_103163.v · Open raw
module autovcoder_103163 (
    input wire req0_i,
    input wire req1_i,
    input wire req2_i,
    input wire req3_i,
    input wire req4_i,
    input wire req5_i,
    input wire req6_i,
    input wire req7_i,

    /* The grant signal coming in from the next stage of the select tree */
    input wire grant_i,

    output wire grant0_o,
    output wire grant1_o,
    output wire grant2_o,
    output wire grant3_o,
    output wire grant4_o,
    output wire grant5_o,
    output wire grant6_o,
    output wire grant7_o,
    /* OR of the request signals, used as req_i for next stage of the select tree */
    output wire req_o
);

  wire [7:0] req;
  wire [7:0] grant;
  reg  [7:0] mask;

  /* Code to deal with vectors instead of individual wires */
  assign req = {req7_i, req6_i, req5_i, req4_i, req3_i, req2_i, req1_i, req0_i};
  assign req_o = |req;

  /* Gate the current grant output with the grant_i from the next stage of the select tree */
  assign grant0_o = grant[0] & grant_i;
  assign grant1_o = grant[1] & grant_i;
  assign grant2_o = grant[2] & grant_i;
  assign grant3_o = grant[3] & grant_i;
  assign grant4_o = grant[4] & grant_i;
  assign grant5_o = grant[5] & grant_i;
  assign grant6_o = grant[6] & grant_i;
  assign grant7_o = grant[7] & grant_i;

  integer j;
  always @* begin : encoder
    mask[0] = 1'b1;
    for (j = 1; j < 8; j = j + 1) begin
      if (req[j-1] == 1'b1) mask[j] = 0;
      else mask[j] = mask[j-1];
    end
  end
  assign grant = req & mask;

endmodule

Protocol summary; the Stage 2 runner creates a fresh prompt.

Stage 1 output → abstraction gate → fresh Stage 2 input. The intermediate text is generated separately for each model/attempt. It is not a prefilled golden description. Stage 2 receives neither the clean RTL nor the Stage 1 conversation.

Reference RTLClean RTL in the imported source record; hidden from Stage 2.
